question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Evanescent**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Enduring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Evanescent"** means something that is fleeting, vanishing, or lasting only for a very short time. (क्षणिक/अस्थायी)
 
 
• **Example:** The evanescent beauty of a sunset leaves us in awe, even though it lasts only a few moments.
 
 
 
• **"Enduring"** refers to something that is lasting, permanent, or continuing over time despite challenges or changes. (स्थायी)
 
 
• **Example:** His love for music is enduring, having lasted throughout his entire life.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the opposite of **'Evanescent' **is **'Enduring'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Enduring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ephemeral** (क्षणभंगुर): Something that lasts for a very short period of time.
 
 
• **Example:** The joy of winning the lottery was ephemeral, as money brought its own challenges.
 
 
 
• **Transient** (क्षणिक): Something that is temporary or short-lived.
 
 
• **Example:** The transient nature of the spring bloom makes it even more precious.
 
 
 
• **Fleeting** (क्षणिक): Something that passes quickly or is momentary.
 
 
• **Example:** She caught a fleeting glimpse of the bird before it disappeared into the forest.
 
 

10d:T739,

The correct answer is** option 4.**
